traps.statement: A normalized distribution covariance is singular along its normalization constraint; a full-rank inverse loses that constraint.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.normalized_rule.

traps.statement: A prediction and data at different particle levels or fiducial definitions compare different quantities.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.frame_declared.

traps.statement: Marginal errors alone omit supplied bin correlations and cannot replace their covariance.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.covariance_assembled.

traps.statement: Rescaling a lower-order shape to a different-order rate without a declaration hides the prediction convention.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.prediction_convention.

traps.statement: A fixed-order prediction outside its supplied low-momentum validity domain need not describe the observable.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.validity_range.

traps.statement: A routine reference and measurement bundle from different source revisions can disagree after a source correction.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.reference_version.

traps.statement: A matrix-element strong coupling different from the selected PDF coupling is an inconsistent input prescription.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.alphas_consistent.

traps.statement: A scale envelope does not itself specify a Gaussian or a bin correlation model.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.prescription_declared.

traps.statement: Replica and Hessian member populations require different uncertainty formulas and declared confidence rescaling.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.pdf_error_type.

traps.statement: Applying a nonperturbative correction to inputs that already include it counts the correction twice.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.np_once.

traps.statement: An electroweak correction combined with QCD without its additive and multiplicative comparison hides combination uncertainty.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.ew_combination.

traps.statement: A supplied prediction may omit required continuum, loop-induced or interference terms sharing its final state.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.amplitude_complete.

traps.statement: Impact assessed using data already fitted by the selected PDF set is circular.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.pdf_not_circular.

traps.statement: Validation on observables used to select a tune is not held-out evidence.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.tune_heldout.

traps.statement: Combining measurements from a shared dataset or systematic source as independent double counts information.
traps.check: Inspect the supplied records with check:sm.measurement_overlap.

handoff: Append mechanisms to the interpretation trap registry, not the legacy fixed trap-sweep population. Merge corresponding premise and convention rows and regenerate knowledge together.
